nodes.label: Case Notes Detail View — Case Review Note for Nexo Commercial Distributors Corp.
nodes.description: UI screenshot of a 'Case notes' detail page in the Captio application. Displays case #6 for 'Nexo Commercial Distributors Corp.' categorized as Business / Contract. Shows a note titled 'Case review' with content about reviewing the case with the client and receiving files. The note hierarchy UI shows: (1) 'BELONGS TO (PARENT NOTES)' panel indicating the note is independent with no parent, and (2) 'NOTES UNDER THIS ONE' panel showing a child note titled 'About the files' with partial preview text. Navigation breadcrumbs include back-to-Cases and back-to-Notes buttons. A 'Delete note' action button is present. User avatar 'T' (tole) visible in top-right.
ui_patterns: hierarchical note tree with parent/child relationships
case context header with case number badge and category tags
child note cards with title and content preview
design_decisions: two-panel layout for note hierarchy (parent above, children below)
independent note indicated by italic placeholder text
child notes shown as clickable cards with truncated preview
case metadata (number, name, category) persisted in sub-page header
nodes.purpose: Demonstrates the case note detail/view screen of Captio, specifically the hierarchical note structure feature allowing notes to belong to parent notes and have child notes, within the context of a legal case management workflow.
